issues.detail: The Greek 'πολλης δε ασιτιας υπαρχουσης τοτε' describes the state of the people (being in a state of much famine at that time), but the Vietnamese translates it as 'Vì đã kiêng ăn lâu ngày' (Because [they] have been abstaining from eating for a long time). The Greek refers to an external condition (famine/scarcity) rather than a voluntary action of 'abstaining'.
